query:
WITH args AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM UNNEST(
        $1::UUID[],
        $2::TEXT[],
        $3::UUID[],
        $4::TEXT[]
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS o(brief_unit_id, label_text, label_fluent_message_id, value_text, ord)
),
objs AS (
    INSERT INTO rev.brief_unit_input_choices (
        brief_unit_id,
        label_text,
        label_fluent_message_id,
        value_text,
        created_at
    )
    SELECT
        args.brief_unit_id,
        args.label_text,
        args.label_fluent_message_id,
        args.value_text,
        now()
    FROM args
    ORDER BY args.ord
    RETURNING id, brief_unit_id, label_text, label_fluent_message_id, value_text, created_at
)
SELECT
    objs.id,
    objs.brief_unit_id,
    objs.label_text,
    objs.label_fluent_message_id,
    objs.value_text,
    objs.created_at
FROM objs
ORDER BY objs.id;
